request.deadline: March 2027 after a 9-month delivery period from July 2026 to March 2027
deliverables: Stewardship structure and economic foundations for launch
Audited bridge running on Cardano mainnet in federated and SPO threshold custody modes under controlled access
request.what: Fund Phase 1 of Bifrost, a Bitcoin-Cardano bridge, to move from working testnet to launch readiness.

claims.claim: Bifrost is designed as a permissionless Bitcoin-Cardano bridge secured by Cardano's existing SPO ecosystem that brings BTC onto Cardano as a native Cardano asset.
The proposal requests ₳12,332,031, approximately $1,973,125 at 0.16 USD/ADA, including a 10% refundable contingency, for a 9-month delivery period.
By the end of Phase 1, Bifrost will be an audited bridge running on Cardano mainnet in both federated and SPO threshold custody modes under controlled access.
Public rollout and 24 months of operations are excluded from this request and planned for a Phase 2 proposal in Q1 2027.
Bifrost custody is described as distributed across 400+ Cardano SPOs weighted by delegation, requiring a cryptographic threshold representing the majority of delegated stake to move funds.
The proposal says Bifrost is already live on testnet under Catalyst Fund 14 with working peg-ins and peg-outs and participating SPOs.
The document states the Catalyst Fund 14 grant funded ₳739,000 for architecture, testnet MVP, and documentation, with milestones M1 and M2 done and approved.
Bifrost's smart contracts, off-chain tooling, and SDK are stated to be open source under Apache 2.0.
The proposers claim Bifrost has no bridge token, no founder allocation, and no built-in revenue claim for the founding teams.
The proposal targets 1,200 BTC TVL, about 600,000 annual transactions, and 3,000 fBTC-holding wallets by Q2 2029.

summary: The document requests ₳12,332,031 for FluidTokens and Lantr Engineering to prepare Bifrost for controlled Cardano mainnet launch by March 2027, with most major technical, adoption, and economic benefits asserted in the proposal rather than independently evidenced in the supplied text.
